card.name: The letter N after a number
card.fires_on: The letter N (or n) right after a number or inside a short code, where it means normality, chromosome count, a compass direction, or a code letter.

modes.label: Normality of acid
modes.description: N after a decimal number in the strength of a hydrochloric acid solution.

modes.label: Chromosome number
modes.description: Lowercase n after a multiple in ploidy terms such as 4n or 8n.

modes.label: Other coded N
modes.description: N in coordinates, virus names, URLs or NDC labels.
modes.example: H7<<N>>9 infections and fatalities in China
